mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problems (type, content, image_url, reference_text, explanation, blank_reveal_count, status, department_id, created_by) VALUES (#{type}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, #{referenceText}, #{explanation}, #{blankRevealCount}, #{status}, #{departmentId}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE problems SET content = #{content}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, reference_text = #{referenceText}, explanation = #{explanation}, blank_reveal_count = #{blankRevealCount}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE problems SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE problems SET department_id = #{departmentId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.type, p.content, p.status, p.department_id, d.name AS department_name, p.created_at, COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT t.name) FILTER (WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL), '{}') AS tags FROM problems p JOIN departments d ON d.id = p.department_id LEFT JOIN problem_tags pt ON pt.problem_id = p.id LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.id = pt.tag_id
AND p.department_id = #{departmentId} AND p.type = #{type} AND p.status = #{status} AND p.created_at >= #{createdFrom} AND p.created_at < (#{createdTo} + INTERVAL '1 day') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM problem_tags fpt JOIN tags ft ON ft.id = fpt.tag_id WHERE fpt.problem_id = p.id AND lower(ft.name) = lower(#{tag})) AND p.content ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY p.id, d.name ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
